author: implementation agent (recording decisions given by the User)
note: These decisions resolve the seven questions in AUDIT-ROADMAP-P3-READINESS-AND-DECISION.md section 6 and authorise a bounded Roadmap P3 implementation (D-P3-F). They approve no phase completion: User approval of the delivered state is recorded separately under 'completion' and remains PENDING.
precedent: D-P7-B required roadmap P3 to be satisfied before P7 and withheld authorisation to start it. D-P3-F supplies that authorisation with a named scope and a named forbidden scope.

decisions.title: Exactly two low-risk adapters: Codex and OpenCode
decisions.decision: Implement real adapters for exactly two low-risk targets: Codex and OpenCode.
decisions.rationale: The architecture's target table marks Codex and OpenCode as low risk; the other candidates are moderate or high risk and are not required for P3.
decisions.bounded_scope: Two adapters only. Adding any further adapter requires a new decision.

approval.basis: Explicit User decision: 'D-P3-A: Implement real adapters for exactly two low-risk targets: Codex and OpenCode.'

decisions.title: Adapter maturity rules
decisions.decision: VERIFIED requires a recorded exercise/evidence; EXPERIMENTAL is acceptable when the generic fallback remains available; DECLARED alone is insufficient for P3 completion.
decisions.rationale: A self-asserted VERIFIED label is the same defect class that keeps CAP-P03-005 blocked. An adapter that cannot be exercised honestly stays EXPERIMENTAL.
decisions.bounded_scope: Maturity labels only. No adapter may claim VERIFIED without recorded evidence of an actual exercise.

approval.basis: Explicit User decision: 'D-P3-B: Adapter maturity: VERIFIED requires a recorded exercise/evidence; EXPERIMENTAL is acceptable when the generic fallback remains available; DECLARED alone is insufficient for P3 completion.'

decisions.title: Declarative-only adapters, confined to the adapter surface
decisions.decision: Use declarative-only adapters under core/adapters/<id>/. Do not create or modify agent-convention files outside the adapter surface.
decisions.rationale: Keeps every vendor-named artefact inside the sanctioned, deletable surface and preserves the one-way dependency rule.
decisions.bounded_scope: No agent-convention file is created or modified anywhere in the repository.

approval.basis: Explicit User decision: 'D-P3-C: Use declarative-only adapters under core/adapters/<id>/. Do not create or modify agent-convention files outside the adapter surface.'

decisions.title: Definition of 'delete all adapters' for the portability criterion
decisions.decision: Delete all adapters means deletion of all per-agent adapter entries/directories. The core-owned adapter contract and registry remain. An empty adapter registry [] is valid and must be accepted by the portability test.
decisions.rationale: The maximal reading would delete the contract and registry that validate-sps2.sh requires; this definition keeps the exercise meetable without amending an approved validator, and the empty registry is already a proven valid state (test_boundary_empty_adapter_registry).
decisions.bounded_scope: Defines the portability exercise and rollback only.

approval.basis: Explicit User decision: 'D-P3-D: Define "delete all adapters" as deletion of all per-agent adapter entries/directories. The core-owned adapter contract and registry remain. An empty adapter registry [] is valid and must be accepted by the portability test.'

decisions.title: Fresh-agent resume targets the whole repository, mechanically
decisions.decision: Fresh-agent resume must target the whole repository, using a mechanical checklist, because current authoritative state is distributed beyond .sps/ and the historical docs/ assumption is stale.
decisions.rationale: The literal '.sps/ + docs/' target set is stale (PHASE-05) and the referenced root docs/ does not exist; the newest authoritative state lives in sps2/.
decisions.bounded_scope: Defines the target set and method of the fresh-agent dry run only.

approval.basis: Explicit User decision: 'D-P3-E: Fresh-agent resume must target the whole repository, using a mechanical checklist, because current authoritative state is distributed beyond .sps/ and the historical docs/ assumption is stale.'

decisions.title: Bounded Roadmap P3 implementation authorisation
decisions.decision: Roadmap P3 implementation is authorised within this bounded scope: two adapters; adapter conformance/portability test; required P3 governance/evidence; the two specifically identified guard corrections.
authorised_scope: the adapter conformance/portability test per D-P3-D/E
required P3 governance and evidence records
the two guard corrections per D-P3-G
decisions.rationale: D-P7-B deliberately withheld authorisation to begin roadmap P3 work; this decision supplies it with a named scope and a named forbidden scope, per the standing rule that phase work needs its own User authorisation.
decisions.bounded_scope: Exactly the four authorised items. Everything else is explicitly forbidden until separately authorised.

approval.basis: Explicit User decision: 'D-P3-F: Explicitly authorise Roadmap P3 implementation within this bounded scope: two adapters, adapter conformance/portability test, required P3 governance/evidence, the two specifically identified guard corrections.' with the explicit forbidden list recorded verbatim in explicitly_forbidden.

decisions.title: Exactly two guard corrections, applied at the invariant level
decisions.decision: Authorise exactly these two guard corrections and no broader weakening: (1) update the P7-readiness one-adapter pin so a legitimate Roadmap P3 adapter does not falsely fail with ADAPTER_STATE_CHANGED; (2) update TestAgentNeutrality so it does not incorrectly treat the intended adapter surface as core agent leakage, consistent with the existing validate-sps2.sh and core_is_adapter_free boundary.

guard_corrections.change: the one-adapter DECLARED pin is replaced by a claim check derived from D-P3-A/B/D and the roadmap's 'Approval: user' rule: the registry must be contract-valid, and a SATISFIED claim additionally requires the delivered state and a User-attributable completion approval

guard_corrections.guard: sps2/tests/test_p5.py TestAgentNeutrality, and the copy of the same invariant in sps2/tools/validate-p5.py section 2
guard_corrections.change: the adapter surface (core/adapters/) is excluded from the vendor-name walk, exactly as validate-sps2.sh section 8 and core_is_adapter_free already do; negative controls keep the check non-vacuous

decisions.rationale: Any real adapter carries a vendor-named agent_id. Freezing the guards would make the roadmap's own deliverable unshippable; silently weakening them would remove real controls. Both corrections are recorded here, applied at the invariant level, and keep their negative controls.
decisions.bounded_scope: Exactly two guard corrections. No other guard may be weakened, and no guard may be edited silently.

approval.basis: Explicit User decision: 'D-P3-G: Authorise exactly these two guard corrections and no broader weakening: 1. update the P7-readiness one-adapter pin so a legitimate Roadmap P3 adapter does not falsely fail with ADAPTER_STATE_CHANGED; 2. update TestAgentNeutrality so it does not incorrectly treat the intended adapter surface as core agent leakage, consistent with the existing validate-sps2.sh and core_is_adapter_free boundary.'
